Container.Name: Folio
Container.Overview:
Folio: a self-hosted home loan statement monitor and payoff forecaster. Import your loan and account statements, check the interest the bank charged, track offsets, spending by category and credit cards, and see when the loan is paid off.
Needs a PostgreSQL database (for example the official postgres image, version 16). Set the Database URL and a Secret key before the first start. See unraid/README.md in the project for the step-by-step setup.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL database (for example the official postgres:16 image), with a database and user for Folio.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Folio is opened on.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where Folio writes its automatic backups (database and statement files). In Folio, Settings, Server, leave the backup folder empty or set it to /backups.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: 32 or more random characters (make one with: openssl rand -base64 32). Encrypts account numbers and two-step secrets. Keep a copy somewhere safe and never change it: a backup only reads those back with the same key.

Config.Name: Folio address
Config.Description: The address people use to open Folio, for alert and invite links, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://folio.example.com. Starting with https:// also turns on HTTPS-only cookies.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, for backup times and dates.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true only when every request reaches Folio through your own reverse proxy (for example Nginx Proxy Manager or Cloudflare Tunnel). Leave empty when people open Folio directly.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy addresses
Config.Description: Addresses of proxies in front of that one, comma-separated. See docs/security/REMOTE-ACCESS.md.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: false: always a plain sign-in cookie (when people also open Folio over plain HTTP at home). true: always HTTPS-only. Empty: decided from the address.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access team
Config.Description: Your Cloudflare Zero Trust team name, when Cloudflare Access is in front of Folio.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access home bypass
Config.Description: true: people on the home network or VPN need no Access sign-in.

Config.Name: Require a login proxy
Config.Description: true: visitors from outside the home network must come through a login proxy such as Authelia (needs Behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Largest restore (MB)
Config.Description: The largest backup file the admin can restore, in MB (2048 when empty).

Config.Name: Turn off background jobs
Config.Description: 1: no automatic backups or alert sending (for testing only).
